text: The in-fight readouts: vitals bar, weapon name with magazine and reserve, credits, ability and frag counts, a #slots container that shows only the current weapon's tier label (no weapon slot cards are ever built; the .slot styles match no element), red damage vignette, damage-direction wedge, concussion overlay and stamina bar. A crosshair, rotation dot, hit marker, reload ring with label and floating damage numbers sit outside #hud so they can follow the mouse in screen space. A legacy #reloadBar is still in the DOM but never shows (CSS display:none; JS only sets its opacity).

Drivers in shamble-game.js: element refs 1096-1098 and 1820, concussion 1043-1047, damage vignette and direction wedge 1542-1545, dryFire 1858, rankLabel 1861 and updateRank 1865 (writes the current weapon tier; appended to #slots with the hidden pipWrap at 3309, called from updateWeaponHUD 2413), updateWeaponHUD 2413, updateHealthHUD 2414, creditValEl 2415 and updateCreditHUD 2416 (change-only), staminaBarEl 2342 and its update 2784-2787, showHitmarker 2495, damage-number pool _dnPool 2499 and spawnDamageNumber 2500-2506, change-only writers _sd/_so/_st 2606-2608, reload ring update 2687-2689, placeCursor 3045; reloadBar opacity writes at 1162, 1379, 1387, 1412, 1827, 1846

Keep: the DOM HUD over a WebGL canvas, writes only on change, pooled damage numbers, and the cursor-following reticle (the Foxhole camera in the CLAUDE.md vision line). LOOP_V2 §7 feel kit (hit marker, kill confirm) and split feedback (hit feedback arrives when the hit is confirmed) change when the marker fires. The active reload (LOOP_V2 §7) needs a timing window on the reload bar or ring. Weapon slots, if v2 shows them, must be built from loadout data (legacy builds none). The credits readout becomes the personal $ readout (LOOP_V2 §3). The tier label is the remnant of the gun-game rank display (its pips are dead, PG17).
